words.en: Rafting is the sport or activity of travelling down a river on a raft.

words.tr: n. 排名；名次； v. “rank”的现在分词；
words.ex: His ranking in the competition is first.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的排名是第一。
words.en: A ranking is a relationship between a set of items such that, for any two items, the first is either 'ranked higher than', 'ranked lower than' or 'ranked equal to' the second.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.ex: She buys soft fabrics for her dresses.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己的连衣裙购买柔软的布料。
words.en: Fabrics are materials made by weaving or knitting fibers together, used for making clothes, curtains, etc., or the structure or foundation of something.

words.tr: adj. 被保险的； v. 确保；“insure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The insured car was repaired after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被保险的车在事故后得到了维修。
words.en: Covered by insurance; a person or entity whose life or property is covered by an insurance policy.

words.tr: n. 洗发水；洗发精；洗发香波；
words.ex: She bought a new shampoo at the store.
words.ex_cn: 她在商店买了一瓶新的洗发水。
words.en: Shampoo is a liquid soap that is used for washing your hair, or the act of washing your hair with this liquid.

words.ex: The cat is roaming around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在花园里四处游荡。
words.en: If you roam an area or roam around it, you wander or travel around it without having a particular purpose.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.tr: adj. 棒极了；令人敬畏的；令人畏惧的；
words.ex: The concert was awesome!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会棒极了！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awesome, you are emphasizing that you think that they are very impressive or extraordinary.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.tr: v. 孵化；孵出；孵化( hatch的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The eggs hatched after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这些蛋在三周后孵化了。
words.en: If an egg hatches or if it is hatched, it breaks open and a baby bird, fish, insect, or other animal comes out. If you hatch a plot or a scheme, you plan it secretly.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: v. 压碎； adj. 压碎的；捣碎的；v. 压碎（crush的过去分词）；
words.ex: He crushed the can with his foot.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚把罐子压碎了。
words.en: If something is crushed, it is pressed or squeezed with force so that it is damaged or its shape is destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.tr: adv. 在任何时间；无论何时；
words.ex: You can call me anytime.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: at any time; whenever

words.ex: Falcons fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在天空中高飞。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey that is known for its speed and ability to dive at high speeds to catch its prey.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: Microbes live in the soil and help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 微生物生活在土壤中，帮助植物生长。
words.en: Microbes are very small living things, especially ones that cause disease, which can only be seen with a microscope.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the blankets every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫每天下午都睡在毯子上。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of thick cloth, especially one which you put on a bed to keep you warm.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳旋转。
words.en: To move in a circle around a central point or to center around a main point or topic.

words.ex: He ate two portions of rice.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了两份米饭。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it or a certain amount of it.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: v. 迁移；迁移，移往( migrate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Birds migrated south for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类迁徙到南方过冬。
words.en: To migrate means to move from one region or habitat to another, especially regularly according to the seasons, or to move from one country or region to another in order to settle there.

words.ex: Cars drive fast on highways.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: She sells garments at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上卖衣服。
words.en: Clothes, especially formal clothes.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.tr: v. 恢复；“restore”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 恢复的；复原的；
words.ex: The old house was restored to its original state.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子被恢复到了原来的状态。
words.en: If something that has been lost or stolen is restored to its owner, it is returned to them.

words.tr:
n. 相反；
adj. 相反的；
words.ex: The contrary of hot is cold.
words.ex_cn: 热的相反是冷。
words.en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.ex: The soldier followed the commands quickly.
words.ex_cn: 士兵迅速执行了命令。
words.en: Commands refer to orders or instructions given by someone in authority.

words.tr: n. 探测器；检测器；发现者；
words.ex: The detector found a hidden metal object.
words.ex_cn: 探测器发现了一个隐藏的金属物体。
words.en: A detector is a device that is used to discover the presence of something, such as smoke, metal, or radiation.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: The old man is the guardian of his grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是他的孙子孙女的保护人。
words.en: A guardian is someone who has the legal authority and responsibility to take care of someone else, especially a child whose parents have died.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr: v. 排除，不包括在内；排除，不包括在内( exclude的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Children under 12 are excluded from the game.
words.ex_cn: 12岁以下的儿童不被允许参加这个游戏。
words.en: If you exclude someone from a place or activity, you prevent them from entering it or taking part in it.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimise waste in your daily life.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you minimise a risk, problem, or unpleasant situation, you reduce it to the lowest possible level, or prevent it increasing beyond that level.

words.ex: The note on the fridge is a reminder to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱上的便条是提醒买牛奶的东西。
words.en: A reminder is something that makes you think about or remember someone or something else.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewellery to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewellery consists of objects that are worn for personal adornment, such as bracelets, rings, necklaces, and earrings, often made from precious metals and gemstones.

words.ex: The sugar dissolved in the water.
words.ex_cn: 糖溶解在水里。
words.en: Having been broken down or dispersed in a liquid; having been officially ended or dismissed.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.tr: adj. 感兴趣的；策划阴谋（intrigue 的过去式和过...； v. 引起……的兴趣；
words.ex: I was intrigued by the strange story.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个奇怪的故事感到感兴趣。
words.en: If you are intrigued by something, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的；
words.ex: He was unwilling to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you are unwilling to do something, you do not want to do it and will not agree to do it.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.tr: v. 排练；排演；排练，排演( rehearse的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The actors are rehearsing for the play.
words.ex_cn: 演员们正在为这场戏排练。
words.en: If you rehearse something, you practice it in order to be prepared for a performance or event.

words.ex: This is a biological experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生物学实验。
words.en: Relating to biology or living organisms.

words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.ex: He finished his coursework last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周完成了他的课程作业。
words.en: Coursework refers to the work that students do during a course of study, which is often assessed as part of their final grade.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.ex: The councillor spoke at the town meeting.
words.ex_cn: 这位议员在镇会上发表了讲话。
words.en: A councillor is an elected member of a local government council.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.ex: The museum displayed ancient engravings on stone.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了石碑上的古老雕刻。
words.en: Engravings are designs or pictures that have been cut into a surface, especially as a form of artistic expression.

words.ex: The university sent me the prospectus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 大学给我寄了这门课程的简章。
words.en: A prospectus is a formal document that describes a new project, business, or product, especially one that is offered for sale or investment.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；特别的； v. “specialise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He works in a specialised hospital for children.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家专门治疗儿童的医院工作。
words.en: Designed or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: The company hired consultants to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了顾问来解决问题。
words.en: Consultants are people who provide expert advice professionally.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.tr: v. 预料；“anticipate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预期的；
words.ex: He anticipated the rain and brought an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他预料到会下雨，所以带了伞。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: The expeditions explored the deep jungle.
words.ex_cn: 这些探险队探索了茂密的丛林。
words.en: An expedition is a journey organized for a particular purpose, such as exploration or research.

words.tr: n. 政治家；政客；“politician”的复数；
words.ex: Politicians make laws for the country.
words.ex_cn: 政治家为国家制定法律。
words.en: Politicians are people whose business is politics, especially members of parliament or congress.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.tr: n. [ similarity ]的复数形式; 类似( similarity的名词复数 ); 相像性
words.ex: There are similarities between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子有相似之处。
words.en: The state or fact of being similar; resemblance.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The photographer took pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位摄影家拍了日落的照片。
words.en: A photographer is a person who takes photographs, especially as a job.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.ex: The fridge uses refrigeration to keep food cold.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱使用制冷来保持食物冰凉。
words.en: The process of cooling or freezing (e.g., food) for preservation.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: Ancient civilisations built great temples.
words.ex_cn: 古代文明建造了伟大的神庙。
words.en: Complex societies with developed social, cultural, and political systems, often marked by advancements in arts and sciences.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.tr:
n. 地中海；
adj. 地中海的；
words.ex: He sailed across the Mediterranean last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天横渡了地中海。
words.en: relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.tr: abbr. 脱氧核糖核酸；“deoxyribonucleic acid”的缩写；
words.ex: DNA carries the genetic information in humans.
words.ex_cn: DNA携带人类的遗传信息。
words.en: DNA is a molecule that carries the genetic instructions used in the growth, development, functioning, and reproduction of all known living organisms and many viruses.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: The arid land has little rain and no trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片干旱的土地降雨稀少，没有树木。
words.en: An arid area of land has so little rain that it is very dry and cannot support much vegetation.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: The boy is flying a kite in the park.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在公园里放风筝。
words.en: A kite is a toy consisting of a light frame covered with paper, cloth, or plastic, which you fly in the air at the end of one or more long strings. It is also a bird of prey with long pointed wings and a forked tail.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: The kids raced their go-karts on the track.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在赛道上驾驶他们的小型赛车比赛。
words.en: A kart is a small, low motor vehicle, usually without a roof or doors, used for racing or recreation.

words.ex: The small isle is surrounded by blue sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海洋环绕着。
words.en: An isle is a small island.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr:
adj. 荷兰的；
n. 荷兰人；荷兰语；
words.ex: He ate Dutch cheese for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了荷兰奶酪。
words.en: Dutch refers to anything related to the Netherlands, including its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: Atoms are the smallest parts of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: Atoms are the smallest units of matter that have the properties of an element. They consist of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.

words.ex: The bank showed a debit on my account.
words.ex_cn: 银行在我的账户上显示了一笔借记。
words.en: A debit is an accounting entry that results in either an increase in assets or a decrease in liabilities on a company's balance sheet.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: She adds fresh herbs to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加新鲜香草。
words.en: Herbs are plants with leaves, seeds, or flowers used for flavoring food, in medicine, or as fragrances.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.tr: n. 害虫；有害的人或物( pest的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The farmers sprayed poison to kill pests.
words.ex_cn: 农民喷洒农药来杀死害虫。
words.en: Pests are insects or small animals which damage crops or food supplies.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: He tightened his grips on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住了把手。
words.en: The act of holding something tightly or the ability to understand something.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助我的承诺。
words.en: To fulfil means to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.ex: The nobleman rode in a surrey to the ball.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族乘坐四轮马车去参加舞会。
words.en: A surrey is a type of light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with two seats facing forward, used in the 19th and early 20th centuries. It is also the name of a county in southeastern England, known for its scenic beauty and historical significance.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: My passport will expire next month.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
words.en: If something such as a contract or a visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: The child looked sleepy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后看起来想睡觉。
words.en: If you are sleepy, you are tired and ready to go to sleep.

words.ex: He has kind traits that make people like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有善良的特质，让人喜欢他。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.ex: The tribes live in the forest far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 这些部落生活在远离城市的森林里。
words.en: A tribe is a social group consisting of people of the same race or nationality who share the same customs, traditions, and language.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: I don't like coffee anymore.
words.ex_cn: 我不再喜欢咖啡了。
words.en: If something does not happen or is not true anymore, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.tr: adj. 确定的； v. 向…保证；“assure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was assured that the package would arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他确定包裹明天会到。
words.en: If you are assured of something, you are certain to get it or achieve it.

words.tr: v. 宠坏；搞糟；变质；“spoil”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被宠坏的；
words.ex: Her parents spoiled her with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母用太多玩具宠坏了她。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a child, as spoiled, you mean that they behave badly because they are given everything they want. Spoiled food or drink has decayed and is not fit to be eaten or drunk.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: The robot has sensors to detect obstacles.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人有传感器来检测障碍物。
words.en: Devices that detect or measure a physical property and record, indicate, or otherwise respond to it.

words.ex: The birds flew high in the heavens.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: The heavens are often referred to as the sky, especially when regarded as a place where the sun, moon, stars, and planets are situated, or more generally as the apparent vault of the sky.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: He ate an avocado for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个牛油果。
words.en: A green, pear-shaped fruit with a creamy texture and a large seed, often used in salads and guacamole.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr: adj. 玷污的； v. “stain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The white shirt was stained with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 这件白衬衫被咖啡弄脏了。
words.en: Something that is stained has been marked or discolored, often in a way that is considered unattractive or undesirable.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.ex: She wrapped the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸把礼物裹了起来。
words.en: To cover or surround something with paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: The farm has 50 hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有50公顷土地。
words.en: A metric unit of area equal to 10,000 square meters, commonly used for measuring land.

words.tr: adj. 不需要的；多余的；无用的；
words.ex: The unwanted clothes were donated to charity.
words.ex_cn: 不需要的衣服被捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: If something is unwanted, it is not wanted or desired.

words.tr: v. 最大化；使增加至最大限度；
words.ex: We want to maximise our profits this year.
words.ex_cn: 我们想在今年将利润最大化。
words.en: To maximise something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.tr: n. 戏服；服装；衣服；“costume”的复数； v. “costume”的复数；
words.ex: The actors wore colorful costumes for the play.
words.ex_cn: 演员们为这场戏剧穿上了色彩鲜艳的戏服。
words.en: Costumes are clothes that are worn by actors in a play or film, or by someone to make them look like something else, especially at a party.

words.ex: We set up our tent at the campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的野营地搭了帐篷。
words.en: A campsite is a place where people who are camping can stay, often with facilities such as toilets and showers.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr: v. 限制；“confine”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被限制的；狭窄的；
words.ex: He was confined to his room for a week.
words.ex_cn: 他被限制在房间里一周。
words.en: If something is confined to a particular place, it exists only in that place. If it is confined to a particular group, only the members of that group have it.

words.ex: He gave an indirect answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个间接的答案。
words.en: An indirect result or effect is not caused immediately and obviously by a thing or person, but happens because of something else that they have done.

words.tr: v. <正>吃，吞下；<正>吃，吞下( ingest的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He ingested the medicine with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药。
words.en: Taken into the body through the mouth and swallowed, especially referring to food, drink, or medicine.

words.tr: n. 手势；姿态；姿势；手势( gesture的名词复数 ) v. 做手势( gesture的；
words.ex: He used hand gestures to explain the idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用手势来解释这个想法。
words.en: Physical movements of the hands, head, or body used to express meaning or feeling.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.ex: The birds live in the mangrove near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿生活在海边的红树林里。
words.en: A mangrove is a tropical maritime tree or shrub of the genus Rhizophora, characterized by its tangled roots that grow above ground and form dense thickets.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.tr: n. 风车；风车房；玩具风车；
words.ex: The windmill turns slowly in the breeze.
words.ex_cn: 风车在微风中缓缓转动。
words.en: A windmill is a structure with long parts at the top that are turned around by the wind and produce power to crush grain or produce electricity.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.tr: v. 处置；清除；解决；“dispose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理掉了那些旧书。
words.en: If you are disposed to do something, you are willing or eager to do it.

words.tr: adj. 抚慰的； v. “soothe”的现在分词；
words.ex: The soothing music helped her fall asleep.
words.ex_cn: 这抚慰的音乐帮助她入睡。
words.en: Something that is soothing makes you feel calm and relaxed.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.ex: The athletes run fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 运动员们在比赛中跑得很快。
words.en: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: n. 工匠；手艺人；手艺人（craftsman 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The craftsmen made beautiful wooden chairs by hand.
words.ex_cn: 工匠们手工制作了漂亮的木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a person who is skilled at making things by hand.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: Birds are migratory in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天是迁徙的。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by migration; tending to migrate.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: The volcanoes erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: He repainted the old house last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周重新粉刷了那栋老房子。
words.en: To paint something again, especially to give it a new appearance or to cover old paint.

words.ex: The scientist examined the specimens under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在显微镜下检查了这些标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single example of something, such as a plant, animal, or mineral, that is used as a typical example of its kind.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr:
v. 移动；操控；
n. （熟练地）移动；
words.ex: He manoeuvred the car into a small parking space.
words.ex_cn: 他把车开进了一个小停车位。
words.en: A manoeuvre is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care, especially in military tactics or in driving a vehicle. It can also refer to a clever or cunning plan or action designed to turn a situation to one's own advantage.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: v. 刮去痕迹；刻；刻（scratch 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He scratched the name off the table with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀把桌子上的名字刮掉了。
words.en: To make a thin, shallow cut or mark on a surface with something sharp or pointed.

words.tr: v. 遗弃；抛弃；“abandon”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被遗弃了的；
words.ex: They abandoned the old car by the road.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧车遗弃在路边。
words.en: Left behind or deserted; given up.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr:
adj. 指定的；标出的；
vt. 把……定名为；指定；标示；
words.ex: The designated teacher will help the new students.
words.ex_cn: 指定的老师将帮助新生。
words.en: If something is designated for a particular purpose, it is set aside for that purpose.

words.ex: I saved my presentation as powerpoint.
words.ex_cn: 我把我的演示文稿保存为 PowerPoint 文件。
words.en: A software program developed by Microsoft that allows users to create, edit, and show presentations, primarily consisting of slides.

words.tr: v. 使某物蒸发掉；消失；不复存在；
words.ex: The sun evaporates the water from the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑里的水蒸发掉。
words.en: Becomes vapor or gas, especially through heating or evaporation; disappears gradually.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: The dark clouds are an indication of rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是下雨的迹象。
words.en: An indication is a sign which suggests, for example, what people are thinking or feeling.

words.ex: He added many quotations from Shakespeare in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在论文中引用了许多莎士比亚的名言。
words.en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, play, etc., which is repeated by someone else. It can also refer to a statement of the current price of a security or commodity.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr: adj. 令人安心的； v. “reassure”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her smile was reassuring.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑令人安心。
words.en: If you find someone's words or actions reassuring, they make you feel less worried about something.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.ex: The fog reduced the visibility on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 雾降低了高速公路上的可见性。
words.en: The condition of being able to see or be seen; the degree to which something can be seen, especially in weather conditions.

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The tradition originated in ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: If something originates from a particular place, time, situation, or person, it begins to exist or happen in that place, at that time, in that situation, or because of that person.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: He puts recyclables in the blue bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把可回收物放进蓝色垃圾桶。
words.en: Materials that can be processed and used again.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
words.ex_cn: 空调使房间保持凉爽。
words.en: A conditioner is a substance that you put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The doctor did an examination of his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生对他手臂进行了检查。
words.en: An examination is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr:
adj. 中断的；
v. 打断；中断；
words.ex: The interrupted signal made the call drop.
words.ex_cn: 中断的信号导致通话断了。
words.en: If something is interrupted, it is stopped or paused, especially because of an unexpected event.

words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.ex: Geographers study maps and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 地理学家研究地图和河流。
words.en: A geographer is a scientist whose area of study is geography, the study of Earth's physical environment and human habitat.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.tr: n. 对应物；职务相当的人；“counterpart”的复数；
words.ex: The Chinese version has counterparts in the US.
words.ex_cn: 中文版本在美国有对应物。
words.en: A person or thing that corresponds to or has the same function as another person or thing in a different place or situation.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.ex: Psychologists study how people think and feel.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家研究人们如何思考和感受。
words.en: Psychologists are professionals who study the human mind and behavior, applying their knowledge to help individuals understand and overcome their mental health issues.

words.tr: adv. 或者；作为一种选择；
words.ex: You can take the bus, or alternatively, walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 你可以坐公交车，或者 alternatively，走路去学校。
words.en: Used to introduce a suggestion that is different from the one already mentioned.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；“entrepreneur”的复数；
words.ex: Entrepreneurs start new businesses to make money.
words.ex_cn: 企业家创办新企业来赚钱。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.ex: They found an archaeological site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们在河边发现了一个考古遗址。
words.en: Relating to the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.ex: The organisational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.ex: He eats a lot of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃很多冰淇淋。
words.en: A large number or amount; a great deal.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: I want to go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我想去公园。
words.en: would like to do something

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢（做某事）；想要；愿意
words.ex: I like to eat apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢吃苹果。
words.en: To enjoy doing something or to have a preference for it.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: I am a bit tired today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天有点累。
words.en: A bit means to a small extent or degree.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上有一些苹果。
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: We should talk about the plan for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该谈谈明天的计划。
words.en: To discuss or mention a particular subject.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.ex: He visited Paris last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年去了巴黎。
words.en: The year before the current one.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.ex: I talk to my friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天和我的朋友聊天。
words.en: To speak to someone in order to give information, express thoughts or feelings, or discuss something.

words.ex: We get to the park by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘公交车到公园。
words.en: If you get to a particular place, you arrive there. If you get to do something, you have the opportunity to do it. If something gets to you, it affects you emotionally.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: I have a look at the book.
words.ex_cn: 我看了看这本书。
words.en: To take a brief look at something.

words.tr: phrase. 如此多；非常；这么大量
words.ex: He has so much homework today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天有这么多作业。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: He tries to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他设法在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: He is known as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位好老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.tr: 短语. 剩余的；其余的（用于指代某事物中尚未提及或尚未处理的部分）
words.ex: He ate the apple, and gave the rest of the food to his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果，把剩下的食物给了他的狗。
words.en: The remaining part or parts of something.

words.ex: He ate too much candy and felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多糖果，感觉不舒服。
words.en: An excessive amount; more than is necessary or desirable.

words.ex: He has much more time than me.
words.ex_cn: 他比我有更多的时间。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something, indicating a significantly greater amount or degree.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。
words.en: To reside or exist within a particular place or environment.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.ex_cn: 书在笔旁边。
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To pay attention to someone or something in order to hear what is being said, sung, played, etc.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: Water is the most important thing for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命中最重要的东西。
words.en: Of the greatest significance or priority.

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.ex: He left early, according to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 根据老师的说法，他早早离开了。
words.en: In accordance with or as stated by something.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: The quantity, volume, or extent of something.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: We will get there by bus.
words.ex_cn: 我们坐公交车去那里。
words.en: To reach a destination or to achieve success.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: He has a range of hobbies, like swimming and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如游泳和画画。
words.en: A variety or assortment of things.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.ex: He gave me his phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的电话号码。
words.en: A phone number is a sequence of digits assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 转向；变成；求助于；致力于
words.ex: He turned to the left at the corner.
words.ex_cn: 他在拐角处转向左边。
words.en: If you turn to someone or something, you go to them for help or advice.

words.ex: Can you help with my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？
words.en: To provide assistance or support with a task.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 与…交谈；向…说话；涉及，关乎
words.ex: I will speak to my teacher tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要和我的老师谈谈。
words.en: To address someone directly in speech; to communicate with someone verbally.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.ex: He feels much better after resting.
words.ex_cn: 他休息后感觉好多了。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is significantly improved or more desirable.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.ex: This shoe is suitable for walking.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋适合走路。
words.en: If something is suitable for a particular purpose or person, it is right or acceptable for that purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.ex: He walks to the city centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去市中心。
words.en: The central part of a city, where there are often many shops, businesses, and cultural attractions.

words.ex: People around the world love coffee.
words.ex_cn: 世界各地的人们都喜欢咖啡。
words.en: In or to many countries throughout the world.

words.tr: phrase. 最常见的；最受欢迎的；最流行的；“popular”的最高级
words.ex: This is the most popular song on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这是收音机里最受欢迎的歌曲。
words.en: Most widely liked or preferred by the public.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He is eating lunch right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在吃午饭。
words.en: At this very moment; immediately.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The local people sell fresh fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 当地人在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: Local people refers to the inhabitants of a particular area or community.

words.ex: The store has a wide range of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的鞋子。
words.en: A wide range refers to a large variety or number of different things.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: They go out to watch a movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末外出看电影。
words.en: To leave a place, especially one's home, for a short time, usually for a specific purpose such as entertainment or socializing.

words.ex: Young people like to use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人喜欢使用智能手机。
words.en: Young people are individuals in the early stages of life, typically characterized by their energy, potential, and the challenges they face in growing up.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.ex: You need to have a passport to travel abroad.
words.ex_cn: 你必须有护照才能出国旅行。
words.en: A requirement or necessity for something.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了停车场。
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.tr: phrase. 放进；插入；提出；提交；使就职；进港
words.ex: Put in the keys before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前把钥匙放进去。
words.en: To place something inside or into a particular position or location.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.ex: The cat is sitting at the back of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房间的后面。
words.en: At the back refers to a position behind something or someone.

words.ex: Please sit down and wait for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请坐下等老师。
words.en: To lower one's body into a seated position.

words.ex: He asks about the homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问作业的事。
words.en: To inquire or seek information about something.

words.ex: I prefer to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢走路去学校。
words.en: If you prefer to do something, you like it more than another thing and would choose it if you could.

words.tr: phrase. 与...共事；与...合作； 对...起作用
words.ex: He works with numbers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和数字打交道。
words.en: To collaborate or deal with someone or something in a shared task or activity.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.ex: We aim to help students improve their English.
words.ex_cn: 我们旨在帮助学生提高英语水平。
words.en: If you aim to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

words.ex: He was tired, but he will study later on.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但他稍后会学习。
words.en: At a time in the future; after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
