words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.tr: phrase. 最受欢迎的；最流行的
words.ex: This is the most popular song on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这是收音机里最流行的歌曲。
words.en: The most liked or preferred by many people.

words.ex: Make a note of the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 把会议时间记下来。
words.en: To write down something so that you will remember it.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.tr: phrase. 主要入口；正门入口
words.ex: The main entrance is open from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 主入口早上6点到晚上10点开放。
words.en: The main entrance is the principal entrance to a building or area, often designed for the primary flow of people.

words.ex: He improved his study skills to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他提高了学习技巧以通过考试。
words.en: Study skills are strategies and approaches applied to learning. They are generally critical to success in school, considered essential for acquiring good grades, and useful for learning throughout one's life.

words.ex: They decide on the color for the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定房间的颜色。
words.en: To choose something or someone after thinking carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: He lives in north america.
words.ex_cn: 他住在北美洲。
words.en: North America is a continent entirely within the Northern Hemisphere and almost all within the Western Hemisphere. It can also be considered a northern subcontinent of the Americas.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: At this stage, he is learning to read.
words.ex_cn: 在这个阶段，他正在学习阅读。
words.en: At a particular point or step in a process or series of events.

words.ex: The children are playing all around the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园周围玩耍。
words.en: In all directions or in every part of a place.

words.ex: He waits for half an hour at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交站等了半小时。
words.en: A period of 30 minutes.

words.tr: phrase. 乐意做某事；很愿意
words.ex: I am happy to help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我很乐意帮你做作业。
words.en: Be pleased or willing to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 并不总是；未必总是；不总是
words.ex: He is not always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他并不总是上课迟到。
words.en: Not always means that something does not happen all the time or is not true in every case.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；移到；进一步讨论
words.ex: He finished math and will move on to science.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了数学，接下来要学科学。
words.en: To proceed to the next thing or stage.

words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 商业街；市中心的主要购物街道
words.ex: She bought a dress on the high street.
words.ex_cn: 她在主街上买了一条裙子。
words.en: The main street of a town, especially as the traditional site for most shops, banks, and other businesses.

words.ex: He plays soccer together with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: In addition to someone or something else; alongside.

words.ex: He has enough time to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他有足够的时间完成作业。
words.en: Sufficient or adequate time available to complete a task or activity.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: There are 5 apples and 3 oranges, in total 8 fruits.
words.ex_cn: 有5个苹果和3个橙子，总共8个水果。
words.en: as a whole; including everything or everyone

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读关于……的内容；通过阅读了解到
words.ex: I read about dinosaurs in a book.
words.ex_cn: 我读了一本关于恐龙的书。
words.en: To read about something means to read information concerning that thing, especially in a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: phrase. 更重要的；更为重要的
words.ex: More important, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 更重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: Comparative form of important; used to indicate that something is of greater significance or value than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；掌握；得到；找到某人
words.ex: He tried to get hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To obtain something or to contact someone.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: He taught math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学教数学。
words.en: A primary school is a school for children between the ages of about five and eleven.

words.ex: He can't run a mile, much less a marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他连一英里都跑不了，更不用说马拉松了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of something by suggesting that something else is even more improbable.

words.ex: Young children love to play with colorful toys.
words.ex_cn: 小孩子喜欢玩色彩鲜艳的玩具。
words.en: Young children refer to children who are in the early stages of their life, typically between the ages of one and eight years.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: Other students finished their homework early.
words.ex_cn: 其他学生早早完成了作业。
words.en: Other students refers to students apart from the ones previously mentioned or considered.

words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: The room is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间充满了玩具。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.ex: One way to solve this problem is to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 解决这个问题的一种方法是寻求帮助。
words.en: A one way trip or ticket is a trip or ticket that takes you to a place but not back again.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: He goes to the sports center every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去体育中心。
words.en: A sports center is a place where people can go to participate in various sports and physical activities. It typically includes facilities such as gyms, swimming pools, and courts for games like basketball and tennis.

words.tr: phrase. 合作；共同努力；协同工作
words.ex: They work together to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起努力完成这个项目。
words.en: To collaborate or cooperate with others in order to achieve a common goal.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: 已做；已完成（现在完成时结构，表示动作已经完成）
words.ex: I have done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我已经做完了我的作业。
words.en: To have completed something.

words.ex: He has a set of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他书架上有一套书。
words.en: A group of similar things that belong together or are used together.

words.ex: You can call me at any time.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: At any time means whenever it is needed or desired; it does not matter when.

words.ex: I talked to my friend over the phone.
words.ex_cn: 我通过电话和朋友聊天。
words.en: If you do something over the phone, you do it using the phone.

words.ex: The United Kingdom has four countries.
words.ex_cn: 英国由四个国家组成。
words.en: The United Kingdom is a country in northwestern Europe, consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 一年到头； 全年
words.ex: She plays tennis all year round.
words.ex_cn: 她全年都打网球。
words.en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

words.ex: The movie is too long for me to watch.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对我来说太长了，我看不完。
words.en: Excessively lengthy; beyond a reasonable or acceptable duration.

words.tr: phrase. 第三年；大三（尤指大学第三学年）
words.ex: He is in the third year of high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中三年级。
words.en: The third year refers to the third in a sequence of years, often used to denote the third year of an educational program or project.

words.ex: He walks to school each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行去上学。
words.en: Every day; on a daily basis.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: He travels to other countries every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去其他国家旅行。
words.en: Nations other than one's own.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.ex: He gave first aid to the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 他给受伤的人进行了急救。
words.en: Immediate assistance given to a person suffering from either a minor or serious illness or injury, with care provided to preserve life, prevent the condition from worsening, or to promote recovery.

words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 实习岗位；工作实习安排
words.ex: He did a work placement at a local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地医院完成了实习。
words.en: A work placement is a temporary position with an employer, usually arranged by an educational institution, to give students practical experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: He likes apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that you could also mention

words.ex: Many children live in rural areas far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子住在远离城市的农村地区。
words.en: Rural areas are regions located outside towns and cities, often characterized by a lower population density and a focus on agricultural activities.

words.tr: phrase. 了解更多关于……的信息
words.ex: I want to find out more about the new school.
words.ex_cn: 我想了解更多关于这所新学校的信息。
words.en: discover additional information concerning

words.ex: There is not enough water for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 水不够所有人喝。
words.en: An expression used to indicate that the quantity or degree of something does not meet the required or desired level.

words.ex: She traveled to south america last summer.
words.ex_cn: 她去年夏天去了南美洲。
words.en: South America is a continent in the Western Hemisphere, mostly in the Southern Hemisphere, with a relatively small portion in the Northern Hemisphere. It is bordered on the west by the Pacific Ocean and on the north and east by the Atlantic Ocean; North America and the Caribbean Sea lie to the northwest.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: The accident was a result of careless driving.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故是粗心驾驶的结果。
words.en: As a consequence of something.

words.ex: When it comes to math, he always feels nervous.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他总是感到紧张。
words.en: You use 'when it comes to' to introduce a subject or activity that you are about to discuss or deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 艰苦的工作；努力的工作
words.ex: He passed the exam through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Hard work refers to a great deal of effort or labor.

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.tr: phrase. 最常见的；最普遍的；最普通的
words.ex: The most common word in English is 'the'.
words.ex_cn: 英语中最常见的词是 'the'。
words.en: Most common refers to something that occurs more frequently than other things of the same kind.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的后面；位于……的背部或后方
words.ex: The cat is at the back of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫在房间的后面。
words.en: Located directly behind something.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.ex: He uses a mobile phone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A mobile phone is a telephone that you can carry with you and use to make or receive calls wherever you are.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书；工具书；参考资料书籍
words.ex: He uses reference books to find answers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考书来找答案。
words.en: Books intended to be consulted for authoritative information rather than read through.

words.ex: Only a few students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有少数学生通过了考试。
words.en: Indicates a small number of something.

words.ex: I need more time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要更多时间来完成作业。
words.en: Require a greater amount or quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.tr: phrase. 不在城里；出城；到外地
words.ex: He is out of town this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周不在城里。
words.en: If someone is out of town, they are not in the town where they usually live or work.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.ex: He attempted to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他试图爬这座山。
words.en: To try to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: He pays attention to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他专心听老师讲课。
words.en: Attention to refers to the act of focusing or concentrating on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. + v. 如何使用；怎样利用
words.ex: I don't know how to use this app.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道怎么使用这个应用。
words.en: The method or procedure for using something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the conference centre.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在会议中心举行。
words.en: A conference centre is a building or complex designed to host conferences and meetings, often equipped with facilities such as meeting rooms, auditoriums, and exhibition spaces.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的位置；适当
words.ex: The books are in place on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地放在书架上。
words.en: In the correct position or location; ready for use.

words.ex: The weather today is not too bad.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气还不错。
words.en: Used to say that something is fairly good or satisfactory, though not excellent.

words.ex: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: To be held means to take place or occur at a particular time or place. It can also mean to be in possession of something.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.tr: phrase. 背景资料；背景知识
words.ex: He gave us some background information about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我们一些关于这个项目的背景信息。
words.en: Background information refers to the essential details or context that is necessary to understand a particular situation, event, or subject matter fully.

words.ex: The movie will start at 7 PM.
words.ex_cn: 电影将在晚上7点开始。
words.en: To begin or commence at a specific point in time or location.

words.tr: 短语动词. 采取措施处理；对……采取行动
words.ex: We must do something about the noise.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须对噪音做点什么。
words.en: To take action in order to deal with a problem or situation.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.ex: He speaks a sort of broken English.
words.ex_cn: 他说的是一种破烂的英语。
words.en: A sort of is used to indicate that something is similar to but not exactly the same as the thing mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 一直；随时；每时每刻
words.ex: He wears a helmet at all times when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时一直戴着头盔。
words.en: If something happens or is done at all times, it happens or is done all the time or always.

words.ex: He visited his grandparents last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月去看望了他的祖父母。
words.en: The month before the current one.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: He has insight into how the machine works.
words.ex_cn: 他了解这台机器的工作原理。
words.en: An understanding of the true nature of something.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读书目；书单（尤指课程指定的必读书目）
words.ex: He made a reading list for summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天列了一份阅读清单。
words.en: A list of books, articles, or other materials recommended or required for reading, especially in an academic context.

words.tr: phrase. 再几个的；多几个的（用于可数名词，表示数量不多但额外的一些）
words.ex: I need a few more minutes to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要再有几分钟来完成我的作业。
words.en: A small additional number or amount.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.ex: This shirt is good quality.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫质量很好。
words.en: Good quality refers to something that is of a high standard or excellence.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理；对时间的有效规划与控制
words.ex: He practices time management to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他练习时间管理，以便早点完成作业。
words.en: The process of planning and exercising conscious control over the amount of time spent on specific activities, especially to increase effectiveness, efficiency, or productivity.

words.ex: He runs more quickly than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟更快。
words.en: At a higher speed or in a shorter time than before or than someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 一个月；一个月的时间
words.ex: He will finish the project in one month.
words.ex_cn: 他将在一个月内完成这个项目。
words.en: A period of time consisting of approximately 30 days or four weeks.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 登记入住；预约登记
words.ex: I will book in for a hotel room tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预订一个酒店房间。
words.en: To reserve a place or accommodation, especially in a hotel or for an event.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.ex: He left straight away after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后他立刻离开了。
words.en: If you do something straight away, you do it immediately and without delay.

words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；喜爱；对…极感兴趣
words.ex: He is keen on playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热衷于踢足球。
words.en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: He pays the rent each week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周支付房租。
words.en: Every week; once a week.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 主干道；主要公路；大街
words.ex: The car stopped on the main road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在主路上。
words.en: A main road is a major road that is used by a lot of traffic, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.tr: 短语. 明显的差异；很大的不同
words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子有很大的不同。
words.en: A significant or notable distinction or contrast between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 入会费；加入时需缴纳的费用
words.ex: You must pay a joining fee to use the gym.
words.ex_cn: 你要支付一笔入会费才能使用健身房。
words.en: A joining fee is a sum of money that you pay when you become a member of a club or organization.

words.ex: He goes to the gym twice a week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去两次健身房。
words.en: Two times every week.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.ex: He will be away for four weeks.
words.ex_cn: 他将离开四周。
words.en: A period of time consisting of four weeks.

words.tr: phrase. 在这种情况下；在这个案例中；既然这样
words.ex: He is late, in this case, he should call the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，在这种情况下，他应该给老师打电话。
words.en: Under the particular circumstances being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 讲授…；作...方面的演讲
words.ex: He gave a lecture on math basics.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一场关于数学基础的讲座。
words.en: To give a talk or speech about a particular subject, especially as part of a teaching process.

words.tr: phrase. 步行前往；走到（某地）
words.ex: He walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: To travel on foot to a place.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的；多种多样的
words.ex: There is a wide variety of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: A wide variety of means there is a large range of different types of something.

words.tr: phrase. 需要能够；必须有能力
words.ex: I need to be able to read this book.
words.ex_cn: 我需要能够读这本书。
words.en: To possess the necessary skill or ability to do something.

words.ex: He is concerned about his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的成绩。
words.en: Worried or anxious about something.

words.ex: He works well under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下工作得很好。
words.en: Being subjected to stress or coercion.

words.ex: He works hard during the week.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日期间努力工作。
words.en: On weekdays, as opposed to weekends.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.ex: The city has too much air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有太多的空气污染。
words.en: Air pollution refers to the presence of substances in the atmosphere that are harmful to the health of humans and other living beings, or cause damage to the climate or to materials.

words.ex: Well done! You solved the problem correctly.
words.ex_cn: 做得好！你正确地解决了这个问题。
words.en: Used to express approval or praise for someone who has done something successfully or achieved something.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: Ordinary people can make big changes.
words.ex_cn: 普通人也能带来巨大的改变。
words.en: Typical individuals, not famous, wealthy, or specially skilled.

words.tr: phrase. 撰写关于……的内容；就……主题写作
words.ex: He writes about math every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写关于数学的内容。
words.en: To create written content about a particular subject.

words.ex: The local council fixed the broken street light.
words.ex_cn: 当地政府修好了坏掉的街灯。
words.en: A local council is an administrative body that makes decisions on local issues and services within a specific area.

words.ex: We visited a national park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个国家公园。
words.en: A national park is an area of land that is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and is open to the public for enjoyment and education.

words.tr: phrase. 预订（票、位置等）【动词短语】
words.ex: I will make a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我将预订一个酒店房间。
words.en: to arrange or reserve something in advance

words.ex: I don't want to go out for one thing, it is raining.
words.ex_cn: 我不想出去，原因之一是天下雨了。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or argument

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 其他部分的；……的其他部位
words.ex: He ate the apple but left other parts of it.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果，但留下了其他部分。
words.en: Parts of something that are not the main or central ones.

words.ex: Please bring along your notebook to class.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的笔记本带到课堂上来。
words.en: To take someone or something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: There are so many people at the park today.
words.ex_cn: 今天公园里有这么多人。
words.en: A large number of individuals.

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.ex: They move into a new house next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进新房子。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.ex: The city council voted to build a new park.
words.ex_cn: 市议会投票决定建造一个新的公园。
words.en: The city council is the elected group of officials who govern a city.

words.ex: We walked by the sea on a night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一个夜晚沿着海边散步。
words.en: A period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.tr: phrase. 健康问题；身体或心理上的疾病或不适
words.ex: He has health problems because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而有健康问题。
words.en: Issues or conditions that affect the physical or mental well-being of an individual.

words.tr: phrase. 公众；普通民众；大众
words.ex: The members of the public can visit the museum for free.
words.ex_cn: 公众成员可以免费参观博物馆。
words.en: Ordinary people, not officials or experts.

words.ex: The café caters for breakfast and lunch.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆供应早餐和午餐。
words.en: To cater for something means to provide all the things that are needed or wanted for a particular purpose or event.

words.ex: At some stage, he will understand the truth.
words.ex_cn: 在某个时候，他会明白真相。
words.en: At some stage refers to a point in time or a phase in a process that is not specified but is expected to occur.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.ex: The cost is $10 a head for the meal.
words.ex_cn: 这顿饭每人10美元。
words.en: The leader or person in charge of an organization or group.

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.ex: He lives on campus near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园里，靠近图书馆。
words.en: On campus refers to being within the area of land that a college or university occupies, including its buildings and grounds.

words.tr: phrase. 不久的将来；近期未来
words.ex: I will buy a new phone in the near future.
words.ex_cn: 我将在不久的将来买一部新手机。
words.en: The near future refers to a time that is not far away from the present, often implying a period within the next few months or years.

words.tr: phrase. 要点；主要观点；核心内容
words.ex: He listed the main points of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他列出了会议的主要要点。
words.en: The most important facts or ideas about something.

words.ex: He goes to the fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness centre is a place where people go to do physical exercise and keep fit, often equipped with various gym equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 语言学习；习得语言的过程或活动
words.ex: He enjoys language learning every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天学习语言。
words.en: The process of acquiring the ability to understand and use a language.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.tr: phrase. 组成整体；装配；组合
words.ex: He put together a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他做了个三明治当午餐。
words.en: To assemble or compile various parts or elements into a whole.

words.ex: The local community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 当地社区一起清理了公园。
words.en: A local community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, often sharing interests and goals.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.tr: phrase. 训练课程；培训时段
words.ex: The team had a training session at 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 团队在早上六点进行了一次训练。
words.en: A training session is a period of time during which people are taught how to do something or how to improve their skills in a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.ex: Every time I see her, she smiles.
words.ex_cn: 每次我见到她，她都会微笑。
words.en: Each time something happens; whenever.

words.ex: He wants to invest in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他想投资一家小企业。
words.en: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or achieve a result.

words.ex: Please give me your contact details.
words.ex_cn: 请给我你的联系方式。
words.en: Information that enables someone to be contacted, such as a phone number or email address.

words.tr: phrase. 数个世纪以来；长达几个世纪
words.ex: People have used this method for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 几个世纪以来，人们一直使用这种方法。
words.en: For a period of hundreds of years.

words.tr: 短语. 在……方面的增加；……的增长
words.ex: There is an increase in the number of students who like math.
words.ex_cn: 喜欢数学的学生人数增加了。
words.en: A rise in the amount or level of something.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: He solved the problem by using a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 他通过使用计算器解决了这个问题。
words.en: Using something as a method, tool, or means to achieve an end.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.ex: He has a direct line to the manager.
words.ex_cn: 他可以直接联系经理。
words.en: A direct line is a straight line or a direct connection between two points or people.

words.tr: phrase. 特价商品；特价销售
words.ex: The store has special offers on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末有特价优惠。
words.en: Special offers are discounts or deals that are available for a limited time to encourage people to buy a product or service.

words.ex: He has a day off on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期五休息一天。
words.en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work or school, especially because you have a holiday or because you need or want to rest.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心（提供基本医疗服务的机构）
words.ex: He went to the health centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去健康中心做检查。
words.en: A health centre is a building or a place where people can go for medical treatment or advice.

words.tr: phrase. 更高效的；更有效的
words.ex: This machine is more efficient than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器比旧的更高效。
words.en: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

words.tr: phrase. 当地居民；本地住户
words.ex: Local residents walk their dogs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 当地居民每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: People who live in a particular area or community.

words.ex: Please get in touch with me if you have questions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有问题，请与我联系。
words.en: To make contact or communicate with someone.

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.tr: phrase. 详细描写；资产账面价值的有意增加；写文章赞扬
words.ex: He will write up the report tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会写出这份报告。
words.en: To write something in a detailed or formal way, especially a report or account of something.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.ex: The ice age covered big parts of the Earth with ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时代使地球的大部分地区被冰覆盖。
words.en: A period in the Earth's history when ice sheets covered large areas of the planet's surface.

words.tr: phrase. 为…作计划；打算；为…做准备
words.ex: We need to plan for the trip next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为下周的旅行做计划。
words.en: To make arrangements or preparations for something that is expected to happen in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 日常生活；平常的生活状态
words.ex: Math is useful in everyday life.
words.ex_cn: 数学在日常生活中很有用。
words.en: The routine, habitual, or ordinary course of a person's life.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃肉。
words.en: To consume animal flesh as food.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；代替；静坐示威；出席
words.ex: Can you sit in while I go to the bathroom?
words.ex_cn: 我去上厕所的时候你能照看一下吗？
words.en: To participate in a sit-in; to occupy seats in a public place as a form of protest.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.ex: The gym charges an annual fee of $50.
words.ex_cn: 健身房收取50美元的年费。
words.en: A yearly charge for the use of a service or membership.

words.tr: phrase. 体力活动；身体运动
words.ex: He does physical activity every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行体育活动。
words.en: Physical activity refers to any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure.

words.ex: He drinks fresh water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝淡水。
words.en: Water that is not salty, especially water found in rivers and lakes, which is suitable for drinking and irrigation.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
words.en: To consume something as food or to derive nourishment from it.

words.ex: He lives in northern ireland with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在北爱尔兰。
words.en: Northern Ireland is a constituent unit of the United Kingdom, located in the northeast of the island of Ireland.

words.ex: He lives in South Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他住在南非。
words.en: South Africa is a country located at the southern tip of the African continent, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and natural beauty.

words.tr: phrase. 当今；现代；目前的时代
words.ex: In the present day, many people use smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 在当今，许多人使用智能手机。
words.en: The present day refers to the current time period, often used to describe the modern era or the contemporary world.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.ex: He practices essay writing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习写作文。
words.en: The activity or skill of writing essays, especially as part of a student's academic work.

words.ex: He wrote the first draft of his essay last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚写了论文的初稿。
words.en: The initial version of a piece of writing, which is usually revised and improved before being finalized.

words.tr: phrase. 生活周期；存在周期
words.ex: The life cycle of a butterfly includes egg, larva, pupa, and adult.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶的生活周期包括卵、幼虫、蛹和成虫。
words.en: The series of changes that a living thing goes through from the beginning of its life until death.

words.ex: He checks his blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上测量血压。
words.en: The force that blood exerts against the walls of the blood vessels, especially the arteries, as it is pumped around the body by the heart.

words.ex: The library is on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆在二楼。
words.en: The level of a building that is immediately above the ground floor.

words.ex: The car parks are full near the mall.
words.ex_cn: 商场附近的停车场都满了。
words.en: A car park is an area of land or a building where cars can be parked.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的；整个范围的；大量的（用于描述一系列事物）
words.ex: He has a whole range of hobbies, like drawing, swimming, and reading.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如画画、游泳和阅读。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a wide variety or a large number of different things or types.

words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在海岸上；在沿海地区
words.ex: They live on the coast near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在靠近海边的海岸上。
words.en: Located along the edge of the land where it meets the sea or ocean.

words.tr: phrase. 在你面前；在你前面
words.ex: The book is in front of you.
words.ex_cn: 书在你前面。
words.en: Located or positioned ahead of you.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.ex: I met up with my old friend at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 我在杂货店偶然碰到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To come together with someone, especially after arranging to do so.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents once a month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月去看望一次祖父母。
words.en: Used to describe an event that occurs every month.

words.tr: phrase. 以小组形式；成群地；集体地
words.ex: The children play in a group.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们成群地玩耍。
words.en: As part of a collection or assembly of people or things.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.ex: This experiment is the basis for our new theory.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是我们新理论的基础。
words.en: The fundamental reason or foundation for something.

words.ex: They live by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边。
words.en: At or near the sea.

words.ex: The children are playing in the main hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在主厅里玩耍。
words.en: The principal or largest room in a building, used for gatherings or events.

words.tr: phrase. 到达（某地），通常用于较大的地点，如城市、国家等
words.ex: They arrive in London tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天早上到达伦敦。
words.en: To reach a destination, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences between them.

words.ex: The car travels at 100 kilometres an hour.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车每小时行驶100公里。
words.en: A unit of speed expressing the number of kilometers traveled in one hour.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.ex: The fishing industry provides food for many coastal towns.
words.ex_cn: 渔业为许多沿海城镇提供食物。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the catching, processing, and selling of fish and other seafood.

words.tr: phrase. 出错； 发生故障；误入歧途
words.ex: Things can go wrong if you don't follow the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照说明做，事情可能会出错。
words.en: If a situation or event goes wrong, it does not happen in the way you intended or expected, and often has a bad result.

words.ex: He waits for the bus at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交站等公交车。
words.en: A place on a bus route where buses regularly stop to pick up and drop off passengers.

words.tr: phrase. 额外费用；额外成本
words.ex: The extra cost was five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 额外费用是五美元。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid beyond the basic price or rate.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 如此少的（用于可数名词前，强调数量极少）
words.ex: There are so few apples left.
words.ex_cn: 剩下的苹果太少了。
words.en: used to emphasize how small a number of people or things is

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为……的一部分；参与；属于
words.ex: He wants to be part of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他想成为团队的一员。
words.en: To constitute or form a component of a larger whole or system.

words.ex: I will enquire about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 我会查询一下火车时刻表。
words.en: To ask for information about someone or something.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: He is in favour of eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favour of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.tr: phrase. 新南威尔士州（澳大利亚州名）
words.ex: He lives in New South Wales.
words.ex_cn: 他住在新南威尔士。
words.en: New South Wales is a state on the east coast of Australia. It is bordered by Queensland to the north, Victoria to the south, and South Australia to the west. Its coast borders the Tasman Sea to the east.

words.ex: He needs better medical care after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后需要更好的医疗照顾。
words.en: The provision of what is necessary for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease and the maintenance of health.

words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.ex: He saves money every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存钱。
words.en: To keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy something in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 一流的；头等舱；第一类邮件；第一堂课
words.ex: He got a first class result in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了一流的成绩。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as first class, you mean that they are extremely good and of the highest quality.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.ex: Many people live in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。
words.en: Urban areas are regions characterized by high population density and vast human features in comparison to areas surrounding them. Urban areas may be cities, towns or conurbations, but the term is not commonly extended to rural settlements such as villages and hamlets.

words.ex: The public transport system is slow but cheap.
words.ex_cn: 公共交通系统很慢但很便宜。
words.en: A public transport system is a network of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.ex: The length of time for the meeting was short.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间长度很短。
words.en: The period of time that something lasts or continues.

words.ex: He lived in Japan for several years.
words.ex_cn: 他在日本住了好几年。
words.en: A period of several years, often implying a significant length of time.

words.ex: He wrote his email address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的电子邮件地址写在了表格上。
words.en: An email address is a unique identifier for an email account. It is used to send and receive emails over the Internet.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.ex: He appears to be tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something appears to be the way you describe it, it seems to be that way.

words.ex: The students' union organized a food drive.
words.ex_cn: 学生会组织了一次食品捐赠活动。
words.en: An organization in a college or university that represents the students and organizes social and other events.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription fee for the app.
words.ex_cn: 他每月为这个应用支付订阅费。
words.en: A subscription fee is a sum of money that you pay regularly to receive a service, especially a magazine or newspaper.

words.ex: She lives in Great Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她住在英国。
words.en: Great Britain is an island in the North Atlantic Ocean off the northwest coast of continental Europe, comprising England, Scotland, and Wales.

words.tr: phrase. 城市花园；城市中的公共绿地或园林
words.ex: The people grow vegetables in city gardens.
words.ex_cn: 人们在城市花园里种蔬菜。
words.en: Publicly accessible green spaces within a city, designed for recreation and aesthetic enjoyment.

words.ex: He arrived later than his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他比他的朋友来得晚。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time; delayed.

words.ex: The teacher gave us two case studies to read.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们两个案例研究来阅读。
words.en: Detailed examinations of a subject of study (such as a person, group, or event) over time, especially in business, medicine, or education, to analyze its development or outcomes.

words.ex: He wants to go to higher education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后接受高等教育。
words.en: Higher education refers to the level of study that is undertaken at universities, colleges, and institutes of technology, beyond the level of secondary education.
